body:
@JReinhold and me took a look. He thought maybe the `import { Button } from './Button';` was causing an issue since it could refer to `Button.tsx` and `Button.mdx`. So I updated the repro sandbox by changing the MDX file to `ButtonDocs.mdx` but the issue still shows:
```
@storybook/cli v7.0.0-beta.43

info => Starting manager..
info => Serving static files from ././node_modules/@storybook/manager/static at /sb-manager-assets
WARN 🚨 Extraction error on src/components/Button/ButtonDocs.mdx: Error: Unexpected dependency: false
WARN Force closed manager build
ERR! Error: Unexpected dependency: false
```

Thanks!

More progress. Adding the extension explicitly `import { Button } from './Button.tsx';` works. Doesn't make sense since there are no other `Button` file to resolve, and imports of other components work without extension.

TLDR of our talk with @JReinhold:
Considering the rest is documented as "regular without extension" imports and suddenly it has to be different there, it feels uncomfortable if it makes sense.
We should at least understand clearly why this behavior happens.
And then if the extension is necessary, document that, but first understand it.

Thanks again ✨

I looked at this and I think it's an issue with this line:

https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/next/code/lib/core-server/src/utils/StoryIndexGenerator.ts#L208

This code is meant to handle the case of `import * as ButtonStories from './Button.stories'` when the actual filename is `Button.stories.tsx`. But the check is way too loose. I'm surprised this probably hasn't shown up until now.

@shilman that's how I read it too, but I think it's the other way round:

The keys of the `cache`s get set here (based on globs from `main.js`):

https://github.com/storybookjs/storybook/blob/e5cded85e71953d0cb5fcdfec2997ebbdc768674/code/lib/core-server/src/utils/StoryIndexGenerator.ts#L133

So if we are filtering the keys to find the referenced file names, we would simply find keys that match stories globs.

The only reason a cache entry would exist and be `false` would be if it was not processed yet, i.e another docs file. It's all very confusing.

Ok, thanks to some screensharing we worked out that the file that it is matching (incorrectly) is itself (`./Button` being a prefix of `./ButtonDocs.mdx`). 

The prefix part is a bit of a bug but ultimately it could have been importing from `./ButtonDocs` (`.tsx`) and had the same issue. There's no easy way for us to tell what it's matching; but if we search through the index and find a docs or unprocessed file (which by definition is docs) we should just skip it.

issue.title: [Bug]: Error when importing component from mdx: Unexpected dependency: false

### Describe the bug

In sb 7 alpha 50, I am trying to use the documented example of `ArgsTable` in an mdx file. It causes an error in the console.

`WARN 🚨 Extraction error on app\components\buttons\buttons.docs.mdx: Error: Unexpected dependency: false`

### To Reproduce

```shell
The reproduction command seems to fail on my system or terminal. 

My MDX file looks like this:


import { ArgsTable } from '@storybook/addon-docs'
import { Button } from './buttons'

<ArgsTable of={Button} />
```

My button component looks like this:

```
export interface ButtonProps {
  title: string
}

export const Button = ({ title }: ButtonProps): JSX.Element =>
  <button type='button'>{title}</button>
```
```
